payload: {"schema":1,"version":"0.0.52","date":"2026-10-18","lede":"Stroke deposit engine 2.0, face, edge and vertex selection, updated clay and rake brushes with dynamic smoothing, and finer spacing and stroke direction controls.","highlights":["Stroke deposit engine 2.0","Face, edge and vertex selection"],"notesUrl":"https://klaysculpt.com/releases/0.0.52","windows":{"url":"https://github.com/c6ank/klay-releases/releases/download/0.0.52/Klay_Setup_0.0.52.exe","size":394692703,"sha512":"52fd955ce6b451e0643b7ba8da3f8c462037ffb3e2f679b707b0397dcd219ecba8983d70eeced0e9e5cda46ce56b318110dc92a4a2499f97aa171d6288a01395"},"mac":{"version":"0.0.52","url":"https://github.com/c6ank/klay-releases/releases/download/0.0.52/Klay_0.0.52_macOS.dmg","size":506809815,"sha512":"29711e334c7187f7996c5710cdd1a3c723a71f14e46441d86ee8a3afaa84981cde45439ce95775129309dbc1d8e9a81af14719b681aa7e9f718808b1e4029a68"},"items":[{"g":"n","t":"Stroke deposit engine 2.0","b":"Polygon brushes stroke up to five times faster on models of 20 million polygons and more. Every brush benefits.","w":["Brush \u203a Polygon"]},{"g":"n","t":"Face, edge and vertex selection","b":"The Select tool card picks Object, Face, Edge or Vertex from a row of icons; holding V with the Select tool opens a wheel with the same choices. Drag on the model to paint a selection, or from empty space to draw a rectangle or lasso. Selected edges and vertices are drawn in the selection colour.","w":["Toolbar \u203a Select"]},{"g":"i","t":"Clay and rake brushes updated","b":"The Clay Hard, Clay Buildup, Wet slab and Rake Dry brushes have been updated and now use Dynamic by topology for their Smooth operator, so they keep the same feel on light and very dense meshes.","w":["Brush \u203a Polygon \u203a Clay Hard"]},{"g":"i","t":"Stroke direction controls","b":"Ignore stroke reversal keeps a print's orientation when a stroke goes back over the same line, so a box no longer turns around at each change of direction. Smoothing sets how far the brush travels before the print turns, which keeps it steady along a nearly straight line.","w":["Brush \u203a Stamp & Falloff \u203a Direction"]},{"g":"i","t":"Dynamic smoothing by topology","b":"A new Dynamic by topology option for the Smooth operator of polygon brushes adjusts the smoothing to the mesh density under the brush, so a brush keeps the same feel from a light mesh to tens of millions of polygons. When it is on, the Smooth value is the one used on a 20-million-polygon mesh and the row reads Smooth (dynamic). Low boost and Max boost add smoothing at the light and dense ends of the range.","w":["Brush \u203a Operator Blend \u203a Smooth \u203a Dynamic by topology"]},{"g":"i","t":"Finer spacing","b":"The first half of the Spacing slider now covers 1 to 10 % of the brush size in steps of 0.1 %; the second half goes from 10 to 1000 %.","w":["Brush \u203a Stamp & Falloff \u203a Spacing"]},{"g":"i","t":"Finer deposit step","b":"The Deposit step of polygon brushes now goes down to 0.001 of the brush radius, shown with three decimals, and the low end of its slider has more travel for small values.","w":["Brush \u203a Advanced \u203a Performance \u203a Deposit step xR"]},{"g":"i","t":"Armature tool card (in progress)","b":"The Armature tool is still in progress, and its card and behaviour may change in coming versions. The Armature tool card shows the five modes as icons, Build, Pose and Angle for the skeleton and Select and Bone for pins, with a line describing the current mode's gestures. Joint size, bone shape, pose physics, pin physics, part materials and the live skin are now in the card, along with Bake skin to a new layer. A new Tap drops setting chooses whether a plain tap in Build places a ball or a hinge; Shift places the other one.","w":["Tools \u203a Armature"]},{"g":"i","t":"Lattice: selection and mask","b":"The Lattice card has two new options. Use Face / Edge / Vertex moves only the faces, edges or vertices selected with the Select tool, and Use mask keeps the masked part of the model in place. Make the selection or mask before switching to Lattice.","w":["Tools \u203a Lattice \u203a Use mask"]},{"g":"i","t":"Subdivision level in the compact outliner","b":"In compact mode, each polygon mesh row shows its current and highest subdivision level, for example 2/6. Scroll over it, or click its left or right side, to change level; at the highest level the right side adds a subdivision.","w":["Scene \u203a Compact mode"]},{"g":"f","t":"Typing in the toolbar drawer's search now also finds the tools of the Tools section, such as Select, Move and Gizmo."},{"g":"f","t":"Typing T in the toolbar drawer's search no longer switches to full screen."},{"g":"f","t":"A polygon brush with a Box shape and Spacing set to Continuous now deposits a box instead of a rounded stroke."},{"g":"f","t":"Brushes with a Box stamp keep the round cursor. The square cursor returns with Square ring for box brushes and Show the alpha as the stamp shape both turned on in Settings > Brush cursor."},{"g":"f","t":"On very dense meshes, Elastique and other brushes with Reach set to Topology no longer stop at a hard edge inside their falloff."},{"g":"f","t":"Duplicates of a polygon mesh no longer render with holes in Path Tracing after the original is edited, and they keep their outliner thumbnail."},{"g":"f","t":"Faces moved with the Select tool's gizmo no longer disappear during the drag."},{"g":"f","t":"Hovering a joint or bone with the Armature tool no longer flickers; it is outlined like an object under the Select tool, and Ctrl over a joint in Build shows the Select tool's red deselect outline."},{"g":"f","t":"Armatures can be deleted from the outliner, with the right-click menu or the Delete key. An armature row now has its own icon, and its skin is listed as its own row just below it."},{"g":"f","t":"The Armature tool now follows symmetry: adding, connecting, removing, resizing, freezing and posing a joint also applies to its mirrored joint."}],"history":[{"version":"0.0.51","date":"2026-10-17","lede":"The Theatre menu on the Z key, French and Chinese, a faster PBR Fast, curve profiles and Curve tool setups in the library, and the toolbar's tools in the right-click menu.","highlights":["Theatre menu","French and Chinese","Tools in the right-click menu","Lazy mouse card","Curves in the library"],"notesUrl":"https://klaysculpt.com/releases/0.0.51","items":[{"g":"n","t":"Theatre menu","b":"An alternative to the radial hub for the Z key. Holding Z shows up to four rings of brushes, tools and functions above the cursor, and a shelf below it with pages, toggles, sliders and a search across the whole app.","w":["Settings \u203a Radial menu"]},{"g":"n","t":"French and Chinese","b":"Klay's menus, panels and messages are available in French and Simplified Chinese as well as English. The language changes immediately, without a restart. Names you gave to brushes, presets and objects are kept as they are.","w":["Settings \u203a Preferences \u203a Language"]},{"g":"n","t":"Tools in the right-click menu","b":"The viewport's right-click menu has a Tools entry that lists the tools of the toolbar's Tools section with their icons. The active tool is highlighted, and choosing one switches to it.","w":["Viewport \u203a Right-click \u203a Tools"]},{"g":"n","t":"Lazy mouse card","b":"Every brush has a Lazy mouse card. Its header switch turns the lazy mouse on or off, and Length sets how far the brush trails the pointer. Q still toggles it, and holding Q while dragging sets the length. The longest leash is now twice as long as before.","w":["Brush \u203a Lazy mouse"]},{"g":"n","t":"Curves in the library","b":"The library has a Curves category with two views: Profiles, the cross-sections saved in the Curve tool's My profiles, and Curve tools, complete Curve tool setups.","w":["Library \u203a Curves","Curve tool \u203a Curve tools \u203a Save"]},{"g":"i","t":"Faster PBR Fast","b":"PBR Fast now uses a much lighter shader, which raises the frame rate in close-ups that fill the screen, on the desktop and in VR. It keeps the scene lights, shadows, environment lighting, ambient occlusion, vertex paint, the specular colour and a steady emission.","w":["Material \u203a Shading model \u203a PBR Fast"]},{"g":"i","t":"Clearer object selection","b":"With the Select tool, or while holding V, the object under the cursor and the objects caught by a selection rectangle are outlined, while selected objects keep their fill colour. The outline is hidden where another object is in front.","w":["Toolbar \u203a Select"]},{"g":"i","t":"Undock the tool card","b":"The active tool card has an undock button in its header. Undocked, the card docks on the other side of the window, or floats where its header is dropped, and stays visible on every sidebar tab. On the Material and Lighting tabs, the tab's own card undocks into the same place. Its top handle sets the height and the handle on its inner edge sets the width. The same button returns it to the sidebar.","w":["Sidebar \u203a Tool card \u203a Undock"]},{"g":"i","t":"Shorter Symmetry section","b":"The Symmetry section of the right-click menu shows your three most used commands, like Topology; its count button opens the full list. The two Mirror directions are now direct entries.","w":["Viewport \u203a Right-click \u203a Symmetry"]},{"g":"i","t":"Gizmo outer ring scales on all three axes","b":"The Gizmo's outer ring now scales the selection uniformly on all three axes, replacing the screen-plane rotation. The larger ring gives finer control, and scaling up has no upper limit.","w":["Toolbar \u203a Gizmo"]},{"g":"i","t":"Gizmo pivot buttons: Lock, Center and Edit pivot","b":"The Gizmo's padlock is now three buttons. Lock keeps the pivot on the object at its current point, so it moves with the object and clicks on the mesh no longer move it; unlocked, a click on the mesh places the pivot. Center returns the pivot to the centre of the object, and Edit pivot moves or turns the pivot without moving the model.","w":["Toolbar \u203a Gizmo"]},{"g":"i","t":"Invert zoom direction","b":"Two new options invert the zoom direction: one for the zoom drag and one for the mouse wheel. With the drag inverted, dragging up zooms in, as in Blender.","w":["Settings \u203a Navigation \u203a Speed"]},{"g":"i","t":"Middle-drag scrolls panels","b":"Dragging with the middle mouse button over a panel or list scrolls it with the cursor.","w":["Sidebar, Settings and lists"]},{"g":"i","t":"Brush size and strength step shortcuts","b":"Four new shortcuts step the brush size and strength up or down by one increment per press, for keyboards, tablet keys and controllers such as TourBox. They ship unassigned.","w":["Shortcuts \u203a Brush size up / down, Brush strength up / down"]},{"g":"i","t":"Pen side button as middle click","b":"The pen's side button can act as a middle click instead of a right click, so a tap no longer opens the viewport menu.","w":["Settings \u203a Tablet \u203a Pen side button"]},{"g":"i","t":"Default mask preset","b":"Right-click a Mask preset and choose Set as default mask. Klay starts on that preset, and pressing X always switches to it.","w":["Toolbar \u203a Mask \u203a Right-click a preset"]},{"g":"i","t":"Curve ribbons for poly modelling","b":"The Flat profile has two points, so a ribbon is one face wide, and Flip normal turns it to face the other way. With Linear on, Single edge leaves one edge at each corner instead of two, and an arrow on the selected corner drags out a bevel that gains edges as it grows. Moving a dot on a Linear curve no longer twists the rest of the curve.","w":["Curve tool \u203a Profile, Shape, Stroke & dots, Mesh"]},{"g":"i","t":"Order controls for curve objects","b":"A new Order section sets which mesh goes where along the curve. Random has a seed, No repeat, a maximum run and Balance. Sequence has a start, a step, a direction including ping-pong, and Repeat each. Pattern can be mirrored, shuffled per round and followed by gaps.","w":["Curve tool \u203a Objects \u203a Order"]},{"g":"i","t":"Max GPU use for ray tracing","b":"A new setting limits how much of the graphics card the ray-traced view uses, from 50% to 100%. A lower value leaves the system and other applications responsive, and the image converges proportionally slower.","w":["Lighting \u203a Raytrace \u203a Quality \u203a Max GPU use"]},{"g":"f","t":"Holding Ctrl with Trim, B-Scrape, Fill or Level now fills or cuts to the plane instead of raising ridges along the edges of a groove."},{"g":"f","t":"With Orbit around mouse point or Orbit around stroke point, orbiting, zooming or clicking from empty space now keeps the last pivot instead of jumping to an unrelated point."},{"g":"f","t":"On macOS, the FPS readout no longer sits on top of the toolbar."},{"g":"f","t":"In an orthographic view, the gizmo's rings, arms, planes and scale handles can be grabbed again, and dragging an object follows the cursor."},{"g":"f","t":"Duplicating an object inside a group now keeps the copy in that group."},{"g":"f","t":"Repeated Ctrl+D now repeats the last move, rotation or scale for several selected objects and for groups, not only for a single object."},{"g":"f","t":"A mask on a polygon mesh now also protects it from the Draw brush when its Spacing is set to Polywire."},{"g":"f","t":"The Mask mode no longer starts on the Concave preset when Klay opens."},{"g":"f","t":"Voxelize no longer crashes the application at high resolutions on some graphics cards."},{"g":"f","t":"The Boolean live preview now works when an operand is an instance made with Ctrl+D."},{"g":"f","t":"Boolean \"Tag as a zone set\" now creates a Boolean zone set holding A, B and the seam."},{"g":"f","t":"The Scene totals line in the viewport display now counts the triangles of every instance, and shows billions as \"1.3B\"."}]},{"version":"0.0.50","date":"2026-10-15","lede":"Klay and Community asset libraries, shared by Klay libraries","Alpha grading","Preserve edge"],"notesUrl":"https://klaysculpt.com/releases/0.0.50","items":[{"g":"n","t":"Mask brushes with sources and Fill","b":"A mask brush can carry a stack of source layers that decide where it masks: surface measures such as Cavity, Slope, Height and Curvature, ray-traced ones such as Occlusion, Thickness, Contact and Light exposure, and Gradient, Noise, Pattern or an Image. Layers have a blend mode and an opacity, adjustment layers reshape the layers below them, and a Grading card adjusts the final result. Fill applies the brush to the whole mesh, the visible side or the selection in one click.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Mask \u203a Fill \u00b7 Sources \u00b7 Grading"],"k":["[X]"],"n":"Poly meshes"},{"g":"n","t":"Per-pixel Boolean preview","b":"The Boolean live preview can cut each object pixel by pixel along the intersection, so the cut edge matches the applied result instead of following whole triangles. The cut follows sculpting on either object as it happens, and a Sharpness setting trades edge detail for memory. The inside of a Subtract is lit, shadows follow the cut, and the settings are kept between sessions.","w":["Boolean \u203a Live preview \u203a Sharpness"],"n":"Poly meshes"},{"g":"n","t":"Sidebar tabs on both sides of the window","b":"Right-click a tab and choose Dock to left or Dock to right to move it to a second panel on the other side of the window. That panel can keep one tab open at its bottom, be shortened from its bottom edge, or be dragged out to float. The layout is kept between sessions.","w":["Sidebar \u203a tab row \u203a right-click"]},{"g":"n","t":"Klay and Community libraries","b":"The asset library has two online sources beside your own assets: Klay, with official assets, and Community, with assets shared by Klay artists. Get adds an asset to your library under Downloaded.","w":["Asset library \u203a Mine \u00b7 Klay \u00b7 Community"]},{"g":"n","t":"Alpha grading","b":"A Grading card under the alpha stamp remaps the alpha's values without editing the image, with a brightness curve, Levels, Brightness, Contrast, Gamma and Invert. The settings are saved with the brush, and the cursor preview shows the result.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Stroke & Falloff \u203a Alpha \u203a Grading \u00b7 Clay \u203a Stamp \u203a Grading"]},{"g":"n","t":"Preserve edge","b":"A Preserve edge slider keeps a stroke on the face it started on, so Flatten, Polish and the other brushes can cross a hard edge without rounding it. 0 turns it off.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Stamp & Falloff \u203a Advanced stroke \u203a Hard edges"]},{"g":"n","t":"Stroke curves (early work)","b":"A Curve group under a mesh's layers records each stroke made while it is selected as an editable curve. Drag its dots to reshape the stroke, hold B or M to change its size or intensity, and right-click a curve to bake it into a sculpt layer.","w":["Outliner \u203a Layers \u203a Curves \u00b7 Brush tab \u203a Curve \u00b7 Tool card \u203a Curve"],"n":"Poly meshes"},{"g":"n","t":"Invert brush","b":"An Invert brush switch in the Brush section makes a brush work inverted, as if Ctrl were held: a brush that adds material now carves. Holding Ctrl flips it back. The setting is saved with the brush.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Brush \u203a Invert brush"],"k":["[Ctrl]"]},{"g":"n","t":"Override unlit material","b":"Override unlit in a material's right-click menu makes every object use that material in Fast Unlit; the other shading modes keep each object's own material. The material menu now shows an icon beside each command.","w":["Material tab \u203a right-click a material \u203a Override unlit"]},{"g":"i","t":"Remesh is now Voxelize, with even quads","b":"Remesh is renamed Voxelize; its shortcut is unchanged. It now builds an even quad grid, similar to ZBrush DynaMesh, without shading rings on smooth shapes and with about half the polygons at the same Resolution. Project detail back places the original detail on a new sculpt layer.","w":["Outliner \u203a right-click \u203a Voxelize"],"k":["[Alt]+[R]"]},{"g":"i","t":"Boolean Union merges any number of meshes","b":"The Boolean panel has a new layout: the operation comes first, then the mesh that is kept, then the meshes it is combined with. Union accepts any number of meshes, added with Pick meshes, Add selected, or by pressing D with several meshes selected. Subtract and Intersect still use two meshes. The panel now matches the width of the sidebar.","w":["Outliner \u203a right-click \u203a Boolean"],"k":["[D]"],"n":"Poly meshes"},{"g":"i","t":"Sidebar tabs and view buttons","b":"The sidebar tabs are a row at the top of the panel: the current tab is named and opens a list of every tab, and the others sit beside it as icons. Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+0 open the tabs in order. The view buttons have their own strip beside the sidebar, which can be reordered, edited and moved to the other side.","w":["Sidebar"],"k":["[Ctrl]+[1]\u2026[0]"]},{"g":"i","t":"Mask is a toolbar mode","b":"Mask sits in the toolbar's mode row between Polygone and Paint. Tap X to switch to Mask and back, or hold X to mask only while it is held; Tab and the number keys work as in the other modes. Fill and Preview tiles sit beside the slots.","w":["Toolbar \u203a Mask"],"k":["[X]","[Tab]"]},{"g":"i","t":"Brush cursor on the surface","b":"The brush cursor lies on the surface at the size the brush deposits; it can wrap the surface, sit flat or stay a screen circle, and a brush with an alpha can show the alpha's shape. The Brush cursor settings are regrouped into Shape, Motion, Guides and Tessellation.","w":["Settings \u203a Brush cursor"]},{"g":"i","t":"Ray tracing for heavy scenes","b":"In Raytrace, each part of a mesh is traced at the detail it needs for its distance from the camera, so large scenes fit in GPU memory without leaving meshes out. Finer detail loads in the background shortly after the camera stops.","w":["Lighting \u203a Raytrace"]},{"g":"i","t":"Focus: display modes for the rest of the scene","b":"The Focus card has a Display section with the outliner's display modes: Shaded, Dither, X-ray, Fill, Wireframe and Bounds. Every object outside the selection takes that look while Focus is on.","w":["Top bar \u203a Focus \u203a settings card"]},{"g":"i","t":"Rounded colour picker","b":"The colour picker is now a rounded square with a draggable hue handle, and pure white and the full hue can be picked from its top corners. The ten saved colours are kept between sessions and across updates.","w":["Toolbar colour \u00b7 Paint \u00b7 Material \u00b7 Lighting"]},{"g":"i","t":"Card contrast","b":"A Card contrast slider in Settings \u203a Theme makes cards and sub-cards stand out more from the panel. At 0 % the interface looks as before.","w":["Settings \u203a Theme \u203a Interface colors"]},{"g":"i","t":"Smoother Gizmo moves","b":"Moving, rotating and scaling with the Gizmo runs at a steadier frame rate, without the periodic stutter.","w":["Gizmo tool"]},{"g":"i","t":"Smoother pen orbit","b":"Orbiting, panning and zooming with a pen is now as smooth as with a mouse. The Pen navigation card in Settings \u203a Tablet sets the amount, and on Wacom tablets Klay requests the highest report rate.","w":["Settings \u203a Tablet \u203a Pen navigation"]},{"g":"i","t":"Grab: push along the normal, scale and twist","b":"On a poly Grab brush, Ctrl with the left button pushes the area along the surface normal, Ctrl with the middle button scales it and Ctrl with the right button twists it. The combinations can be changed in the Shortcuts tab.","w":["Polygon tab \u203a Grab brush \u00b7 Settings \u203a Shortcuts \u203a Tools"]},{"g":"i","t":"Several Brush tab sections open","b":"Opening a section in the Brush tab no longer closes the others. Each section stays open or closed as you leave it.","w":["Brush tab"]},{"g":"i","t":"One Advanced stroke card","b":"The poly brush Advanced section is now part of the Advanced stroke card in Stamp & Falloff, as the Plane ops, Plane sampling, Hard edges and Crease sub-cards. Refresh every N dabs moved to Build-up.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Stamp & Falloff \u203a Advanced stroke"]},{"g":"i","t":"Tessellation Share values covers every setting","b":"Share values in the Tessellation section now applies to every tessellation setting, including Sizing, Follow creases and the limits. When it is off, each brush keeps its own values. The Shift smoothing brush has a Custom values switch that keeps its own settings even while values are shared.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Tessellation"]},{"g":"i","t":"Smooth / Faceted button","b":"The Smooth / Faceted function can be added to the sidebar buttons or to the action bar above the drawer. The button shows a circle in Smooth and a triangle in Faceted, and a click switches between them.","w":["Sidebar \u203a Add a button \u203a Display"]},{"g":"i","t":"Outliner expand arrow stays in place","b":"In compact mode, the arrow that expands an object card now stays where you clicked it, and the thumbnail appears to its right. The arrow points right when closed and down when open, like the other arrows in the outliner.","w":["Scene outliner"]},{"g":"i","t":"MatCap materials react to scene lights","b":"In PBR Fast, PBR and Raytrace, MatCap materials are now lit and shadowed by the scene lights; Fast Unlit still shows the plain matcap. Light and Shadows sliders in the MatCap section set the amount.","w":["Material tab \u203a MatCap"]},{"g":"i","t":"Ambient occlusion default","b":"The Ambient occlusion section has Set as default and Reset buttons, like the Volumetric and Weather sections. Set as default stores the current values; new scenes and new launches start from them, and Reset returns to them.","w":["Lighting tab \u203a Ambient occlusion"]},{"g":"i","t":"Curve ends extend by dragging","b":"Each free end of a curve now shows an arrow that follows the direction of the curve. Click it to add one point, or drag it to extend the curve along the arrow with evenly spaced points.","w":["Curve tool"]},{"g":"i","t":"Curves for edge modelling: Linear, Rings at dots, Flat profile","b":"Linear makes every segment of a curve straight, with a hard corner at each point. Rings at dots places a ring on every point, with a set number of rings per span between them, so the points act as holding edges under subdivision. The Flat profile, or any profile whose points lie on one line, now builds a single open sheet instead of two overlapping surfaces.","w":["Curve tool \u203a Stroke and Mesh sections, Profile"]},{"g":"i","t":"Asset library sections on a side rail","b":"The asset library now lists its sections in a rail on the left, grouped under Sculpt, Shade and Light, with the number of items in each. The tab row above the grid has been removed, and the window is wider to make room for the rail.","w":["Asset library"]},{"g":"i","t":"Retopology Sharp: Reset to default","b":"In Sharp mode, the Retopology window has a Reset to default button below the settings. It returns Target quads and the other Sharp settings to their default values.","w":["Outliner \u203a Retopology \u203a Sharp"]},{"g":"f","t":"Boolean: the live preview no longer hides random patches of the model."},{"g":"f","t":"Boolean: a model and its duplicate could not be combined. Selecting an object and its copy now runs the Boolean, and other copies of the same object are left unchanged."},{"g":"f","t":"Boolean: the live preview stayed on the shape from before a stroke. It now updates while either object is sculpted or reshaped."},{"g":"f","t":"Boolean: the panel keeps its two operands when they are deselected, and a new two-object selection replaces the operands left over from an earlier session."},{"g":"f","t":"Pen pressure: with pressure on Size, the brush cursor now shows the largest size a stroke can reach, and strokes no longer grow past it."},{"g":"f","t":"Tessellation: Subdivide all scrambled the UVs and seams of a mesh, which could throw vertices off the surface on the next Decimate all or stroke. UVs and seams are now kept."},{"g":"f","t":"Outliner: Filter scene did not find objects inside a collapsed group. It now searches every group."},{"g":"f","t":"Object display: a Dither object that was selected or hovered lost the colour picked for it. The Dither tint now holds under the selection highlight and the Focus dim, as X-ray already did."},{"g":"f","t":"Convert to poly left an unnamed copy of the shape that undo could not remove. The poly mesh is now named after the clay layer, which is hidden rather than deleted."},{"g":"f","t":"Convert to poly could leave most of the new mesh invisible, with only its wireframe and a small patch of surface showing. The whole mesh now draws."},{"g":"f","t":"Leaving a freeze sculpt without making a change could crash the app. It now returns to the clay layer as expected."},{"g":"f","t":"With a MatCap material, the viewport stayed in PBR and Fast Unlit or PBR Fast could not be selected. Every view mode can now be selected."},{"g":"f","t":"MatCap: Blender .exr matcaps did not load in Images mode. They now load, and the 27 matcaps from Blender 5.3 are included."},{"g":"f","t":"Tessellation: with Follow creases on, repeated strokes over the same area could leave lumps and spikes on the surface. Follow creases now only lines the edges up along the bend and no longer adds detail on it."},{"g":"f","t":"Tessellation: starting a stroke while the quick undo strip was stepping back could crash the app."},{"g":"f","t":"Sidebar on the left: the viewport readouts (view, lens, FPS, recording, render progress) stayed at the bottom left, under the sidebar. They now move to the bottom right."},{"g":"f","t":"Subdivision levels: stepping down a level reshaped the lower levels even without sculpting. Lower levels now change only where you sculpted."},{"g":"f","t":"Curve: undo after Bake removed the curve. Undo now restores the editable curve."},{"g":"f","t":"Grab and Elastique brushes cut off sharply at the edge of the brush circle and jumped in steps on long drags, and with symmetry a pull across the middle doubled up. The pull now fades smoothly and stays continuous."},{"g":"f","t":"Clay Grab no longer jumps in steps on a long drag, and Clay Elastique no longer stops pulling past the brush circle."},{"g":"f","t":"Material Bindings and other capsule buttons could turn into a solid highlight after switching or adding a set. The selected button now keeps its normal look."},{"g":"f","t":"Lattice: on a duplicated object, the cage could appear away from the object and did not deform it. It now fits and deforms the duplicate."},{"g":"f","t":"Camera tool: orbiting and moving the view in Raytrace was slower than with the tool off. It now runs at the same speed."},{"g":"f","t":"Navigation: with Orbit around mouse point on, orbiting and zooming now centre on the surface under the cursor."},{"g":"f","t":"Navigation: with Arcball and Trackball off, Orbit around stroke point and Orbit around mouse point made the view jump and spin away. Orbiting now turns around the point without jumping."},{"g":"f","t":"Combine selected turned quad meshes into triangles. The combined mesh now keeps the quads and polygons of each object."}]},{"version":"0.0.49","date":"2026-10-11","lede":"Retopology rebuilt for clean all-quad loops that follow the main edges; Pan speed and an Invert stroke key in Settings; orbit and zoom close in on the point you click; light edits can be undone; Undo always stays on Ctrl+Z.","highlights":["MatCap from an image","Follow creases","Export and import brushes","Sidebar on the left","16-bit clay","View and lens in the Viewport HUD"],"notesUrl":"https://klaysculpt.com/releases/0.0.49","items":[{"g":"n","t":"MatCap from an image","b":"A MatCap material can now use an imported image instead of the procedural look. A pastille at the top of the MatCap section switches between Procedural and Images; in Images mode, Browse loads a PNG, PSD, EXR or HDR file, with Rotation, Flip Y, Intensity and the same Color controls as the procedural look (posterize, hue, saturation, contrast, brightness, gamma). Sixteen-bit and floating-point files keep their full tonal range, so Blender-style matcaps read without banding.
